preregistration.title: PRE-REGISTRATION -- verifier-scoring scope for the 2026-08-13 decoding sweep
preregistration.written_at: 2026-08-13, BEFORE any SELECTED or sel_eff number for any swept setting existed
preregistration.why: The frozen incumbent verifier must be run under HF transformers at batch 1 (vLLM drops visual.* LoRA modules), which measures ~1.5 candidates/s on a shared A100. Scoring all 42 pools was not affordable in the available GPU window, which was additionally contended by two sibling jobs. Rather than score whichever settings happened to look good, the scope is fixed in advance by a rule that does not depend on any selection outcome.

two_tiers.coverage_tier: EVERY generated setting. Needs judge labels only. Endpoints: oracle@8, distinct-candidate count, Lincoln-Petersen capture-recapture ceiling, oracle-vs-N curve, generated-token audit, per-cell oracle.
two_tiers.selection_tier: A pre-specified SUBSET. Needs the frozen verifier. Endpoints: sel_eff, SELECTED accuracy, contested-stratum and laterality-stratum SELECTED, and all paired deltas vs the matched control.

selection_tier_membership_rule: 1. T07 -- the matched control (the deployed setting, regenerated in this session). Mandatory.

2. The setting with the HIGHEST measured oracle@8 among all swept settings, ranked on judge labels alone. Rationale: SELECTED = oracle@8 x sel_eff exactly, so the setting with the largest coverage gain is the one with the best chance of converting into a SELECTED gain. If it does not convert, no smaller coverage gain can.

3. rp11 (repetition_penalty = 1.10). Rationale: a MECHANISTIC harm check fixed in advance, not an outcome-dependent pick. vLLM applies repetition_penalty to tokens in the PROMPT as well as the output (vllm/model_executor/layers/utils.py, apply_penalties -> apply_repetition_penalties(logits, prompt_mask, output_mask, ...)), and on medical VQA the correct short answer is frequently a word of the question ('left', 'right', 'upper', ...). The deployed value is 1.0, so the deployed system takes no harm; the pre-registered prediction is that raising it HURTS, concentrated in the laterality stratum.
4. If GPU time remains after those three, add settings in this fixed order: minp01, T13, T10, T03, T05, minp005, rp105, T13minp010, topk20, topk50, topp09, topp095.

prediction_registered_in_advance.temperature: oracle@8 and distinct-candidate count increase monotonically with temperature; SELECTED does NOT, because sel_eff falls with pool noise. Basis: the project's measured marginal conversion of newly-covered questions is 0.447 [0.368, 0.526], well under 1.
prediction_registered_in_advance.repetition_penalty: rp > 1.0 LOWERS SELECTED, with the damage concentrated on the laterality stratum, because vLLM penalises prompt tokens.
prediction_registered_in_advance.min_p: min_p truncates the tail, so distinct-candidate count and oracle@8 fall slightly while sel_eff rises slightly; net SELECTED approximately flat.
prediction_registered_in_advance.overall: no single-variable decoding change beats the deployed T=0.7 default on SELECTED accuracy.

preregistration.endpoint_and_metric: src/training_methods/genframe_data.py, unmodified. n=2345 (slake_open 645 / vqa_rad_open 200 / pathvqa_open 1500). Paired item bootstrap nboot=10000, seed 20260813.
preregistration.note_on_sel_eff_deltas: sel_eff conditions on each setting's OWN recoverable set, so a sel_eff difference between two settings is not a paired item statistic and is reported as a point estimate only. The paired stratum endpoint is SELECTED restricted to the CONTROL's recoverable set.

three_open_cells_generator_AND_32B_direc.source: src/labeling/run_openvqa.py --cap default 'cap320', MAXPX = 1280*28*28 // 4; NO runner passes --cap for any open-text arm (7B greedy, 7B sc8, or 32B-direct)

consequences: The open half is internally MATCHED (7B pool and the 32B-direct bar are both cap320), so the open-cell comparison is fair -- but it is made at 1/51 of the pixels the MCQ half uses.
The VERIFIER sees each image at 4.0x the resolution the GENERATOR saw it at (1,003,520 vs 250,880). The scorer is strictly better-sighted than the proposer.
run_openvqa.py's own label 'fullres' (1,003,520) is NOT the model's full resolution (12,845,056) -- it is 12.8x smaller. Naming landmine.

Image resolution is therefore UNSWEPT for the open arm and the published operating point was inherited, not chosen on accuracy. This sweep does NOT test it (prompt and cap are held fixed by design); it is the obvious next experiment.

STATUS.why_not: The judge (MedVLThinker-32B, tp=2) needs ~37 GiB free on BOTH A100s simultaneously. For the whole available window two SIBLING JOBS on this shared machine (vision_diversity_* and resolution_open_generate/score) held 59 GiB of GPU0 and up to 74 GiB of GPU1. The judge was left waiting rather than oversubscribing or killing another user's process. SELECTED cannot be computed without judge labels (it is the label of the verifier's picked slot), so the verifier was not the binding constraint -- the judge was.
STATUS.how_to_complete: runners/finish_decoding_sweep.sh -- waits for the already-running, resumable judge, then scores the frozen verifier on the pre-registered selection tier and regenerates this artifact. Every stage is content-addressed, so it only pays for what is missing.
STATUS.does_the_missing_piece_change_the_readin: It could only change it by making the answer MORE negative or by a sel_eff gain large enough to overturn a coverage loss. SELECTED = oracle@8 x sel_eff EXACTLY. Every swept setting loses EM-currency oracle@8 to the control by 0.013 to 0.057 (all CI-clean). To win on SELECTED, a setting losing 0.0132 of oracle (rp11) would need sel_eff to rise from 0.775 to 0.793 (+2.3% relative), and one losing 0.0484 (T13) would need 0.775 -> 0.849 (+9.5% relative). ~27 selector architectures in this project have landed in 0.78-0.81 and the repo calls 0.78-0.81 a FIELD CONSTANT, so a +9.5% relative jump from a DECODING change with a FROZEN selector is not a live hypothesis. This is an argument, not a measurement, and is labelled as such.

completeness.note: a run is measured only when EVERY slot has both a judge label and a verifier score; otherwise it is excluded, never partially scored.
